name: print-social-purple-block-shapes-recruitment-posts-with-cutout-portraits
title: Instagram recruitment posts with stepped violet blocks, coral and yellow squares and cutout portraits
whatItIs: A lavender board showing three Instagram posts side by side: a violet abstract slide, a central post where a smiling woman with arms crossed overlaps a stepped violet block holding 'Simplify talent acquisition' with small coral and yellow squares, and a coral post with a yellow zig shape behind a cropped person.
whatItMeans: Bright and modern; stepped blocks and cutouts feel like a friendly recruiter.
techniques: Build stepped blocks that a cutout overlaps.
Add small coral and yellow squares.
Use a violet, coral and yellow palette.

vocabulary.definition: A rectangle with a stair-like edge.
A person placed in front of a shape.
A card shaped like an Instagram post.
